- **Other candidates** (Eyespot, Tar Spot, Holcus Spot, Physoderma Brown Spot) are clearly different morphologically.

The test image's small, circular, densely packed, orange-brown pustules on the upper leaf surface match Southern Rust much better than Common Rust, which has larger, more elongated pustules.
